prompt: In this project, create a PNG bar chart showing how many rows were added to the links table in each of the latest 12 calendar months. Read the database URL from the project's environment file and use a Python script for the query and plot.

assertions.text: Reads DATABASE_URL from .env or .env.local without printing it
Counts links.created_at over exactly 12 calendar months
Exports a PNG with 12 chronological month labels and a link-count y-axis
Preserves months with no links as zero
